annotations.title: Ladder Arb Scanner — spread/total ladders priced out of order on Kalshi, Novig and Polymarket US (NFL · CFB · NBA · NHL · CBB · EPL · UCL)

description: Use for "is any NBA ladder mispriced tonight", "where can I make a market on Kalshi" and "does Novig or Polymarket US price this strike differently". Spread/total strikes priced out of order on Kalshi, Novig and Polymarket US across seven leagues — NFL, college football, NBA, NHL, men's college basketball, Premier League, Champions League: locked arbitrage, crossed-mid inversions on real two-sided books, wide books worth making a market in, and the same strike priced apart on two venues (cross = tradeable net of both venues' fees, gap = informational), with both ids and books, gross edge, liquidity, as-of and tier. Pro adds the resting orders, net-of-fee edge and quarter-Kelly size on Kalshi and Novig rows; Polymarket US rows are shown for information.

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, max 100; 3 when the call has no arguments).

min_edge.description: Minimum NET edge in cents (default 1). Accepts 2, "2c", "2".

min_volume.description: Minimum per-leg volume in dollars (default 20000). Accepts 20000, "$20,000".

signal.description: locked · inverted · wide · cross · gap · all (default all). cross/gap = the same strike on two venues.

sport.description: cfb · nfl · nba · nhl · cbb · epl · ucl · all (default all; both = all).
